Average wage growth for workers is now at the slowest pace in 5 years — and could soon be eaten up by inflation.

Meanwhile, CEO pay continues to skyrocket through the stratosphere.

Imagine what our economy would look like if worker pay grew like CEO pay.

According to a new report from House Democrats, Americans have spent $8.4B more on gas in the first month of Trump's Iran War.

The death and destruction are all for nothing — and you're paying for it.

The richest 0.1 percent of the global population are hiding nearly $3 trillion in offshore accounts to evade taxes — more than the wealth held by the entire bottom half of humanity.

It would take about $93 billion per year to eradicate extreme hunger by 2030.

Taxing the rich is a global necessity.

Trump’s immigration thugs detained the wife of a newlywed soldier who was training to deploy in the next few months.

ICE detentions and deaths are still at record highs.

Even though it’s not in the headlines, ICE is still carrying out Trump’s campaign of cruelty. Never forget this.

Amazon reportedly failed to create any new jobs at its HQ2 in Virginia last year, despite millions of state tax incentives.

The company has cut 30,000 jobs since last October — while saving $4 billion in taxes under Trump's Big Ugly Bill.

Trickle-down economics is a hoax.

The Trump Organization is now selling "Trump 250" merch tied to America's 250th anniversary.

Meaning the President  is making a personal profit on the nation's birthday.

The grift just keeps grifting.

Working-class Kentucky residents are being forced to leave their mobile home park within 90 days because a Fortune 50 company wants to build a data center next door.

They don't know where they'll go.

Video: Lex18News
Wisconsin, have you reminded three friends to go vote in our election tomorrow? 👀

That one person can drag us into a war without consulting or even notifying Congress beforehand, or our allies, or coherently explain to the American people why this is necessary, is absolutely bonkers. 

Reminder that Congress has the power to stop this.

Throughout history, war has always been part of the authoritarian playbook. 

That’s because war allows so-called "strongmen" to feign strength, even if they are operating from a place of weakness. 

This is exactly what is happening to Donald Trump.

Trump wants to distract public attention from his lousy economy and rotten war and he loves to show he's powerful, so he'll continue to wield the hatchet.

But which Cabinet member will be the next to go? https://robertreich.substack.com/p/office-hours-who-will-trump-fire

“Let those who have weapons lay them down. Let those who have the power to unleash wars choose peace. Not a peace pursued by force, but through dialogue. Not with the desire to dominate the other, but to encounter them.” — Pope Leo XIV

Like most bullies, Trump can be constrained only if everyone stands up to his bullying. 

Keep protesting. Go to town halls. Protect the vulnerable in your community. Keep speaking out. 

The fight against authoritarianism will take all of us — and we can't relent.

Trump's unhinged rampage on "Truth Social" yesterday, where he threatened to inflict war crimes on Iran, has led several lawmakers to call for invoking the 25th Amendment to remove him from office. 

Trump seems to have lost his mind. How much longer will this go on?

Trump is cornered, and he’s going stark-raving mad. Some thoughts on his latest outburst...

https://robertreich.substack.com/p/final-thought-hes-seriously-out-of

Elon Musk is now worth over $800 billion.

Tesla reported paying ZERO federal income tax on $5.7 billion of U.S. income in 2025.

Meanwhile, millions of Americans are living paycheck to paycheck and household debt has risen to a record high.

This is what I mean when I say the system is rigged.

“Let those who have weapons lay them down. Let those who have the power to unleash wars choose peace. Not a peace pursued by force, but through dialogue. Not with the desire to dominate the other, but to encounter them.” — Pope Leo XIV

An upcoming Montana ballot referendum would deny corporations the power to spend in state and federal elections.

If it passes in deep red Montana, it could pass anywhere. State by state, this could effectively nullify Citizens United. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p1fPbGHe3xE

Why does the American tax system favor the wealthy? And how did it get this way? I chatted with Jon Stewart about this back in 2012. Sadly it's only gotten worse since then. We must keep up the fight to fix the system.

American workers face an existential threat not only from AI, but unprecedented levels of corporate greed. Trump doesn't seem to care.
Are you tired of winning yet?
